usedFor: Ascora holds quotes and jobs, and Google Drive shares the matching file after “Quote Created” through “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “Quote Created” in Ascora, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new quote can go out with a shareable link to its file, set to Viewer, Commenter or Editor.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a link to the file, so choose the access level before any quote runs.
